name: @royashbrook/waterbear
description: Keep a CLI agent session alive through crashes, patches, quits, and reboots, and resume the same conversation when it comes back. macOS/launchd + tmux.

scripts.test: bash -n scripts/waterbear-install && bash -n scripts/waterbear-uninstall && bash -n scripts/waterbear-doctor && bash -n scripts/waterbear-selfcmd && bash -n scripts/rc-session-capture-hook && node scripts/check-version-sync.mjs

author: Roy Ashbrook
